text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — high 5xx rate detected in prod-us-west-2. Incident INC-2025-0421. Paging on-call: @mina. Logs and traces attached.

mina: Taking this. Initial symptom: sudden spike in model inference OOMs after the 03:10 canary rollout. Observed increased latency + downstream 502s. I’m SSH-ing into the GPU pool now.

jamal: I can look at autoscaler + node events. Curious if the canary increased sequence length or batch size.

mina: grabbing recent deploy diff. quick grep shows a change to batcher config: default_max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 8192. 🤦‍♀️

sophie: FYI I see customer error counts — roughly 30 distinct API keys with increased errors; two enterprise keys (acme-co, stratify) show >100 failed calls each. Notified account managers.

mina: mitigation plan: revert the canary, roll back config change on the canary group only, then monitor. ops-bot, can you run the rollback play?

ops-bot: Executing: `rtr play rollback --env prod-us-west-2 --group canary-1 --change batcher.max_tokens`

ops-bot: Rollback complete on canary-1 at 03:28 UTC. Health checks passing, error rate trending down.

jamal: autoscaler logs show a bunch of OOM kill events around 03:15-03:20. Looks like memory pressure from bigger KV caches due to the larger batches. Will add annotation to the incident.

mina: good catch. For immediate watch: keep traffic routed to stable pool for 30m. I'll leave a temp config to enforce max_tokens=2048 across canaries.

sophie: customer impact note for postmortem: window 03:12-03:30 UTC, ~18min. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (text), /v1/chat/stream. Potentially important: customers that pinned model versions saw no improvement unless they were on the canary pool.

alex: thanks. We need a quick post-incident sync and then a follow-up postmortem. Can we get a 30-minute ‘mini-retro’ at 09:00 UTC tomorrow? Also propose we create a lightweight remediation ticket list and an action-tracking row.

mina: 09:00 works for me. For the postmortem doc I want a tighter template that includes: automatic customer impact pull, deploy diff link, exact mitigation commands, and a succinct blameless summary.

jamal: +1. Also recommend the incident bot auto-populate metrics (error counts, top N customers) and create a pre-seeded checklist: Repro steps, Root cause hypothesis, Immediate mitigation, Long-term fix, Owners, ETA.

sophie: could we also have the bot create a calendar invite and attach a pre-filled Google Doc with the template? saves manual steps and gets everyone on the same doc.

mina: here’s a quick template snippet — can the bot inject these fields into a new doc? ```
- Incident ID:
- Severity:
- Start/End (UTC):
- Services affected:
- Customer impact summary (auto-populate top 10 keys):
- Deploy/Config diff (link):
- Mitigation steps taken (commands + timestamps):
- Root cause hypothesis:
- Action items (owner, ETA):
- Follow-up meeting notes:
```

jamal: another automation idea: when the bot detects a rollback action, it should auto-tag the postmortem severity provisional as S2 unless customer error thresholds exceed X — reduces triage flicker.

alex: also want an action-tracking dashboard widget that surfaces open incident follow-ups across weeks with owners and status. Right now follow-ups get lost in GH issues and calendar notes.

mina: agree. Minimal MVP: postmortem-bot should create a GH issue under infra/incidents with a checklist, plus add a row to a central sheet/dashboard. Later we can build a dashboard view in Console.

sophie: for next steps: I’ll send a short customer impact summary to AMs and legal where needed. Mina — can you start the GH issue and seed it with the template + the list of affected keys? Jamal — can you add the autoscaler OOM logs and annotate the specific node IDs?

mina: on it. I'll open the GH issue and invite owners. Also will attach the rollback command output and the canary diff.

ops-bot: Created issue infra/incidents#381 — "INC-2025-0421: OOMs after batcher config change (prod-us-west-2)". Assigned: mina, jamal. Checklist seeded.

mina: quick action list copied from thread: 1) Update batcher default_max_batch_tokens to safe guard + unit test for config (owner: jamal, ETA: 2d). 2) Add canary validation harness that simulates long sequences (owner: mina, ETA: 5d). 3) Incident-bot: auto-populate top customers and create calendar invite (owner: alex, ETA: 3d). 4) Postmortem meeting at 09:00 UTC tomorrow (owner: mina). 5) Add follow-ups to dashboard (owner: alex, ETA: 1w).

alex: approving owners/ETAs. I'll create the calendar invite after GH issue is live and add the doc link.

sophie: thanks everyone. small follow-up: please mark any actions you can't do in the ETA as blocked so we can reassign.

mina: will run a quick postmortem draft tonight and paste in the GH issue. Thanks for the fast response — only a few big customers impacted and rollback got us back to baseline.

jamal: +1. Also will add a note to autoscaler repo to crash gracefully when memory pressure spikes (prevent cascade failures).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-0421 marked as "mitigated" at 03:34 UTC. Follow-up issue infra/incidents#381 created.

mina: closing thread for immediate ops updates, see GH issue for async follow-ups. See you all at the retro. :thumbsup:
